---
title: "new release todo"
---


a todo-list for new iLand software releases.

## Source-code/SVN

* create tag/branch in the repository

* link the publicsvn websvn to the branch (see [sourcecode](sourcecode.qmd))

* create and upload doxygen-documentation

## Wiki

* check for private wiki-pages that should go now public

* add/ update the suggested citation of wiki pages

* write blog entries with technical and conceptual release notes

## Software package

* create software-package (executable, DLLs, ...)

* update the "Getting started" (word) document

* provide an example application (and update it'S description in the "Getting started" document)

* save the package to the /get_iland/content folder (see [sourcecode](sourcecode.qmd) for details)

* move the old release package to the release-archive-wiki-page

## Community

* update iLand mailinglist

* write email with release notes to the folks on the iLand email list
